05 — Machine learning

ML survival benchmark

Leaderboard — concordance index (5-fold CV, mean ± SD)

Aim 2 · time to brain metastasis (n = 1,222, 381 events). Harrell C-index; higher is better. Bars scaled 0.40–0.70.

Aim 3 · overall survival (n = 393, 289 events). Random Survival Forest and Gradient-Boosted Survival edge out the Cox baseline; XGB-AFT is the primary ML model reported.

06 — Methods & provenance

Methods by aim

The public GENIE BPC BRCA cohort, prepared into a single analytic frame and run through a consistent statistical and machine-learning stack - classical association and survival statistics alongside nonlinear time-to-event models and XGBoost-AFT.

AimQuestionMethods
1 · AssociationWhich genes / oncogenic pathways are enriched in brain-met patients?Fisher exact, prevalence ratios (log-normal 95% CI), BH correction, logistic regression, forest plots, oncoprints
2 · Time to brain metTime from diagnosis to brain metastasis (no-CNS-at-dx cohort)Kaplan-Meier + log-rank, Cox PH + Schoenfeld, AFT distribution selection
3 · OS & PFSSurvival in the brain-mets-ever cohortSame KM / Cox / AFT machinery, minimum-events guard
ML benchmarkPredictive survival modelingXGBoost-AFT (primary), Random Survival Forest, Gradient-Boosted Survival, LightGBM; Harrell + IPCW C-index; SHAP explainability

Data & provenance

  • Raw and derived data (cBioPortal / GENIE exports, prepared analytic CSVs) are not tracked in version control — the pipeline reads them from a local data/processed/ root.
  • Operates on de-identified public datasets for research and manuscript preparation; it is not a clinical tool.
  • Figures shown here are viewer-optimized (downscaled, palette-quantized) for fast browsing; the manuscript PDFs/PNGs remain the source of truth.
